scoring_justification: Checker reads agent's CSV, extracts the row at p/h=6, and compares to hidden paper-reported values (-1.82, 0.833, -3.10) with relative tolerance 5%; also structural consistency checks (signs, monotonicity).

outputs.description: Parametric sweep of the Rayleigh-Ritz model: p/h from 2 to 20, w/h=1, reporting field-normalized relative X strain, Y strain, and X stress.

output_contract.notes: At p/h=6 the values will be compared to a hidden gold with a relative tolerance; structural consistency (sign, monotonic trends) may also be audited.

hidden_assets.purpose: Paper-reported field-normalized relative strains and stress at p/h=6 (w/h=1) for PSI-5A-S2 material.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: From the paper's text: 'with p/h = 6 field normalized relative free X direction strain levels of -1.82, relative Y direct strain levels of 0.833, and relative stress levels of -3.10'
hidden_assets.generation_method: Values extracted from the paper; they are the reference predictions of the Rayleigh-Ritz model.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the paper's own reported numbers for the identical scenario, traceable to the paper's results section.

steps.note: Scorer combines numeric comparison at p/h=6 and structural monotonicity/signs.
